rating.comments: Student messages (excluding the opening task-like question): '200' gives a bare number; '1L' gives a single value; 'there is 200 students, one student use 1L of water every day, there are 300 days' states a multi-part set of inputs with a brief implicit basis, and it applies the earlier figures to the problem, though the 300-day figure is later corrected. 'yes' confirms the 5-day week, and 'no please do it' asks the AI to do the calculation, so the student asks no content questions and hands the multiplication back.
